device.graphics: swangle for final native smoke and preview; swiftshader for acoustic regression

assessment_model.lexiconChanges: Selected alphabetic headwords; first pronunciation; stress stripped; ARPAbet converted to model IPA token IDs.
assessment_model.method: Quantized phoneme CTC acoustic posteriors, forced alignment and posterior practice index. Not human-calibrated, accent-neutral, prosody or examination scoring.

checks: Local Writing grade, exact suggestion application, invalidation and regrading survive reload/process death without changing SRS
Expanded Writing/audio/sentence/pack libraries and level filters work; adding a pack keeps review schedules
New original bilingual reading opens with all paragraphs, translation and comprehension quiz
Actual ONNX phoneme inference runs offline on verified human audio; matching reference scores above mismatched reference
Silence creates no score; cancellation, audio interruption, retry and background clear pending feedback

scope: All executed suites ran with the final application source/build; older collection/dictionary test result metadata may retain historical version labels. Final installation is attested by the installed-copy hash and independent upgrade capture.

Native acoustic inference used real, licensed recorded speech copied into the app private recording file and verified byte-for-byte; microphone capture/playback was exercised separately. No human calibration or pronunciation-quality accuracy claim.
The complete native smoke suite was rerun successfully with swangle after the earlier emulator graphics crash during video. Failed attempts are not counted as passes.
Writing uses local spelling and conservative grammar rules with four measurable criteria; semantic essay/task accuracy and IELTS bands are not evaluated.
